mapper.select: select distinct m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.name, m.perms, m.type, m.path, m.icon, m.order_num from sys_menu m join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id join sys_role r on r.role_id = rm.role_id join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and m.type !=2 and m.status = 1 and m.del_flag = 0 and r.status = 1 and r.del_flag = 0 order by m.parent_id,m.order_num

select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id join sys_role r on r.role_id = rm.role_id join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rm.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and m.perms is not null and m.perms != '' and m.status = 1 and m.del_flag = 0 and r.status = 1 and r.del_flag = 0
mapper.insert: insert into sys_menu(parent_id, name, perms, type, path, icon, order_num, create_by, update_by)values(#{parentId},#{name},#{perms},#{type},#{path},#{icon},#{orderNum}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy});
